title: Incident Response: Timeline Generation Accuracy
problem: Timeline generation tool misses events due to incomplete registry hive tracking. Timeline gaps hide incident progression.
evidence: Timeline missing key registry modification events
cause: Timeline tool only reads NTFS MFT changes. Missing registry hive snapshots at key timestamps.

recommended_actions.action: Capture registry hive snapshots at each event timestamp for complete timeline

lesson_learned: Registry hive snapshots at each event timestamp solve timeline gaps but introduce storage/performance tradeoff. Selective snapshot strategy at key events more practical than full hive capture.
